about_the_game:
A 2D HENTAI PUZZLE game, with a clean and pleasant graphical interface. Its content consists of 7 levels, each formed by 10 images. We can enjoy these in the Gallery section, where we can maximize the images to appreciate the art of the completed puzzles.

MAIN MENU

We have an interface with interactive elements such as the character in the main menu, with integrated sounds. The background has animated elements like bubbles, and the buttons have visual and sound effects. It is possible to mute all the sound for a comfortable and safe gameplay experience anywhere. In the menu, we will find the character selection section and the gallery.

CHARACTER SELECTION

The game has 7 levels, each with a different character. With various unlockable paths within the game. To do this, you must collect all the stars before time runs out:

  • Yellow: Requires 4 silver stars

  • Purple: Requires 5 gold stars

  • White: Requires 6 gold stars

DIFFICULTY INCREASE

Its difficulty increases as you progress through the levels, moving from a 2x2 puzzle to a 6x6 puzzle.

It has a timer that makes the levels more challenging and replayable, allowing you to unlock characters and platform achievements.
